items.title: 17.13 RLC parallel circuit se AC (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: RLC parallel circuit mein resistor, inductor aur capacitor ek doosre ke parallel AC source se jure hote hain (Fig. 17.12(a)). Parallel jorne se total impedance aur current ki distribution (har branch mein kitna current) badal jati hai, is liye yeh series circuit se alag hai.
